suspension: missing daily bar requires explicit all-day S event; intraday or conflicting records block
corporate_actions: Implemented dividend; mandatory gross cash_div_tax and total stk_div; nullable components NOT_REPORTED, reported components nonnegative and compatible with total (both known must sum exactly); actual event dates required by economic entitlement
factor_check: complete adj_factor series; changes must correspond one-to-one with implemented in-scope actions; factors never used for full-history back-adjustment
preclose_check: causal gross cash/share ex-right bridge rounded HALF_UP to source 0.01-CNY tick
proof: Manifest + exact original response bytes + fields/items wrapper + request + actual clocks + Owner source policy; deterministic rebuild
response_schema: Required fields for every product including empty responses, except the exact registered suspend_d empty-table response with full daily/limit/factor cross-coverage; absence and schema are not proven

checks: exact duplicates retain original row hashes and form unique reference view; conflicting records block

identity_scope: Current basic identity only; no historical ST, relisting or complete exchange exception certification
null_action_amounts: Missing total stock entitlement or gross cash blocks. Component null remains NOT_REPORTED, never zero; a known total is executable without classifying bonus/transfer components.
duplicate_disclosures: Identical economic execution fields, reporting period, implementation announcement and component disclosure values merge once per ex-date; original row hashes/announcement dates retained. Conflicting values/dates block.
unimplemented_events: 预案 / 股东大会通过 / 不分配 / 停止实施 / 预披露 / 股东大会未通过 / 未通过 excluded from execution with process, original row hash and date fields retained; unknown process blocks

empty_suspension_compatibility.label: EMPTY_TABLE_SCHEMA_NOT_RETURNED
empty_suspension_compatibility.requires: valid source/receipt/raw pins, exact scope, clocks; every calendar session positive-volume RAW daily + actual limits + factors
empty_suspension_compatibility.does_not_allow: missing-bar synthesis; other APIs/partial schemas/nonempty bad tables; explicit intraday suspension

predisclosure_conflict: 预披露 carrying record_date, ex_date, pay_date, div_listdate or imp_ann_date must block rather than silently exclude
rejected_proposal_conflict: 股东大会未通过 or 未通过 carrying record_date, ex_date, pay_date, div_listdate or imp_ann_date must block rather than silently exclude
